facts.text: The hotel is set on the Grand Canal in central Venice, near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco.
facts.excerpt: Set on the Grand Canal in the Venice city center near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco

facts.text: The hotel faces across the Grand Canal to the Salute church.
facts.excerpt: with its splendid position facing across the Grand Canal to Salute church

facts.text: The palazzo dates to 1475, when the Pisani family gave it its current Gothic shape.
facts.excerpt: The Gritti Palace dates back to 1475 when the Pisani family, who lived here, transformed it into its current Gothic shape.

facts.text: In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti.
facts.excerpt: In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti

facts.text: John Ruskin wrote 'The Stones of Venice' during a long stay at Palazzo Gritti with his wife Effie.
facts.excerpt: John Ruskin and his young wife Effie spent a long period at Palazzo Gritti where he wrote his famous book 'The Stones of Venice'.

facts.text: Artworks and antiques adorn the hotel's private and social spaces, along with terrazzo floors.
facts.excerpt: from the beautiful terrazzo floors to the remarkable selection of artworks and antiques that adorn all private and social spaces within the hotel

facts.text: Rubelli fabrics cover walls and furniture, with Murano chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: The Rubelli fabrics on walls and furniture positively glow, aided by dazzling Murano chandeliers

facts.text: Rooms feature rare antique furnishings, precious fabrics and Murano glass appliques and chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Rare antique furnishings, precious fabrics and Murano glass appliqués and chandeliers are embraced by walls

facts.text: Venetian '700-style double rooms are adorned with hand-painted wood.
facts.excerpt: our Venetian '700 Style Double Rooms adorned with hand-painted wood

facts.text: Rooms have Signature Luxury Collection beds, marble bathrooms and Acqua di Parma amenities.
facts.excerpt: Signature Luxury Collection beds, luxurious marble bathrooms and Acqua di Parma amenities.

facts.text: The Signature Suites overlook either the Grand Canal or the Santa Maria del Giglio Campo.
facts.excerpt: Signature Suites offer spectacular views of the Grand Canal or the charming Santa Maria del Giglio Campo

facts.text: The Redentore Terrazza Suite is a two-storey suite with a 250-square-metre rooftop terrace overlooking Venice and the Grand Canal.
facts.excerpt: A spectacular two storey suite with a 250 square-meter rooftop terrace and unparalleled views of Venice and the Grand Canal.

facts.text: The top-floor Redentore Suite has a plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Suite, 1 King, Grand Canal view, Top floor, Plunge pool

facts.text: The Coppa Volpi Heritage Suite honours the Venice International Film Festival, and the Fenice Heritage Suite evokes the opera house.
facts.excerpt: The Coppa Volpi Heritage Suite honours the Venice International Film Festival, while the Fenice Heritage Suite evokes the spirit of the Opera House.

facts.text: The Royal Suite holds reminders of former guest Somerset Maugham.
facts.excerpt: original antiques and reminders of a famous former guest and dear friend - the novelist Somerset Maugham

facts.text: The Gritti SPA is branded by Sisley Paris and offers Phyto-Aromatic treatments.
facts.excerpt: Experience the luxurious Phyto-Aromatic Treatments at The Gritti SPA, branded by Sisley Paris.

facts.text: The spa has single and double spa suites and a hammam.
facts.excerpt: The spa, in collaboration with Sisley Paris, has single and double spa suites, a hammam, and aromatherapy treatments.

facts.text: Riva Yacht Experiences take guests on tailored excursions of the northern and southern lagoons.
facts.excerpt: Discover the Venetian archipelago’s heritage and the beautiful panoramas of the northern and southern lagoons with our selection of tailored excursions.

facts.text: The hotel's Riva yacht is an Aquariva Super speedboat named Il Doge.
facts.excerpt: aboard “Il Doge”, our Aquariva Super speedboat

facts.text: The Gritti Epicurean School is an open kitchen that has hosted wine tastings, culinary workshops and celebrations since 1975.
facts.excerpt: A Venetian open kitchen that since 1975 has hosted the social elite of Venice and international guests for wine tastings, culinary workshops and celebrations.

facts.text: Half-day cooking classes start with a visit to the historic Rialto market.
facts.excerpt: Your day starts with a visit to the historic Rialto market

facts.text: Concierge-curated sessions include a guided walk-around of the palace's art, antiques and furniture with an antiques expert.
facts.excerpt: An expert in antiques is offering guests a guided walk-around of the palace’s art, antiques and furniture.

facts.text: Guests can watch a live demonstration by one of the few remaining forcola (gondola oarlock) masters.
facts.excerpt: One of the few remaining fórcola Masters is offering a live demonstration workshop for our guests.

facts.text: Club del Doge Restaurant sits in a corner position on the Grand Canal and pays tribute to Venetian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Exuding the aura of a sophisticated club from its corner position on the Grand Canal, Club del Doge Restaurant is a fresh tribute to the timeless wonders of Venetian cuisine

facts.text: The Riva Lounge is an outdoor terrace overlooking the Grand Canal, with sunset views over Santa Maria della Salute.
facts.excerpt: the Riva Lounge overlooks the Grand Canal and is the quintessential outdoor setting for gathering from early evening until late and relaxing Dolce Vita-style with magnificent sunset views over Santa Maria della Salute Basilica

facts.text: The Concierge desk is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
facts.excerpt: The Concierge desk at The Gritti Palace is available 24 hours, 7 days a week.

facts.text: Guests can arrive by water taxi at the hotel's private pier.
facts.excerpt: Take a water taxi to our private pier from Marco Polo Airport, Piazzale, Roma, Santa Lucia Railway, and the maritime port.

facts.text: The Accademia Bridge is steps away from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: just steps away from The Gritti Palace, head to the Accademia Bridge

facts.text: The hotel is near the Peggy Guggenheim Collection and the Punta della Dogana contemporary art museum.
facts.excerpt: Located near the Peggy Guggenheim Collection and Punta della Dogana Contemporary Art Museums

facts.text: The hotel sits right by a number of big-name designer boutiques.
facts.excerpt: The hotel sits at a seriously chic point on that route, right by a slew of big-name designer boutiques.

facts.text: The busy tourist route from the Accademia to Piazza San Marco is just around the corner.
facts.excerpt: The heavily trafficked tourist route from the Accademia to Piazza San Marco is just around the corner

facts.text: Under Italian law on historic palaces, rooms cannot have an iron; a pressing service is offered instead.
facts.excerpt: Due to the Italian law on Old Historical Palaces, we cannot offer an iron in the room, however we offer a pressing service.

facts.text: Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at The Gritti Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Venice do not permit rollaway beds.

facts.text: High tide (acqua alta) occurs more often in autumn and winter, when sea water partly covers some areas of the city.
facts.excerpt: High tide occurs more frequently during autumn and winter when the sea water partially covers some areas of the city.

facts.text: The hotel is listed as a Michelin 2 Key hotel.
facts.excerpt: Michelin 2 Key Hotels / Michelin Guide
